Hardworking opening working rules for desk cover
The purpose of this section is to describe what applies on every shift
Companion Animal Travel Desk Shift Standards

The Companion Animal Travel Desk keeps pet travel orderly, calm, and fully documented from check-in to handoff. Staff give passengers plain guidance before departure, confirm crate and care details, and pass concerns to the cabin team without delay. <<FACT F001>> Any animal that shows stress, injury, or paperwork gaps is moved to the next review step at once, with the senior coordinator notified and the record updated.

Desk staff use steady language, keep the counter uncluttered, and treat each animal with patient attention. When a passenger arrives with a pet such as Mia, the first duty is to verify the travel file, check visible condition, and explain the next steps in simple terms. If the situation stays routine, the desk continues with standard acceptance. If anything changes, staff follow a calm stepwise review and do not guess, improvise, or promise an outcome.

The desk also keeps close contact with boarding crews so animal handling stays consistent across the journey. Reports must be complete, direct, and limited to facts. When a traveler raises a concern, staff listen, answer clearly, and move the case to the proper lead without argument.

For any unresolved issue, contact the senior coordinator or the duty supervisor through the normal desk channel.
